ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY (02)
Applications are invited for appointment of Guest faculty (02) in the Department of Oral and
Maxillofacial Pathology and Oral Microbiology at Dr. Harvansh Singh Judge Institute of Dental
Sciences & Hospital, Panjab University, Chandigarh for Undergraduate/Postgraduate courses
session 2024-2025.
Essential Qualifications:
(i) MDS in Oral Maxillofacial Pathology and Oral Microbiology from DCI recognised
Institutions with Research and Publication Points as required by DACP scheme.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must registered with any state
Dental Council of India as per DCI guidelines.
Teaching Experience:At least three years of teaching experience after obtaining the post
graduate qualification i.e. MDS or its equivalent as Senior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator/
Registrar/Lecturer/Senior Lecturer/Assistant Professor in the concerned speciality in a DCI
recognised Dental College.Research experience and publication points as per DCI regulations as
amended from time to time.
Honorarium:
The appointment of Guest Faculty is on lecture basis with taken honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidates shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any Financial Assistance from
any agency and will do the same till that are teaching in Dr. Harvansh Singh Judge Institute of
Dental Sciences & Hospital, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Instructions for applicants:
 The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at P.U. website
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429.
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf?112707
461024
 The applications supported by relevant testimonials must reach the office of
department Dr. Harvansh Singh Judge Institute of Dental Sciences & Hospital,
Panjab University, Chandigarh by Tuesday 10.12.2024 till 05:00 p.m. by hand or
through post.
 The interview for the post will be held in the office of the Principal-cum-Professor,
Dr. Harvansh Singh Judge Institute of Dental Sciences & Hospital, Panjab University,
Chandigarh. The date and time of the interview will be intimated to the shortlisted
candidates by e-mail. The applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and
other relevant documents for verification at the time of interview.
 No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
